title: Data Science Intern (AI/ML/DL Intern)
description:
### **Job Description**

A Data Science Intern assists in collecting, analysing, and interpreting data to help organisations make data-driven decisions while gaining practical experience with real-world datasets and projects.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Collect, clean, and pre-process data from various sources.
* Analyse datasets to identify trends and patterns.
* Create reports, dashboards, and visualisations.
* Assist in building predictive models and machine learning solutions.
* Perform statistical analysis and data validation.
* Support data-driven decision-making processes.
* Document findings and present insights to the team.
* Work on live projects involving business data and analytics.

### **Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of Python or R.
* Understanding of statistics and mathematics.
* Familiarity with Excel, SQL, and data visualization tools.
* Basic knowledge of Machine Learning concepts.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and presentation skills.

### **Qualification**

* Any Degree/Diploma/PG/ITI
* Fresher’s Can Apply

### **Job Type**

Full Time /Part-time
  
Work from Home (WFH)
  
Work from Office (WFO)
  
Hybrid (WFH + WFO)

Location: Kakkanad, Kochi

Interested candidates may apply by mailing their resume on hr@wahylab.com
